decisions: Migrated from GSD (.planning/, archived with _ARCHIVED.md) to the agentic-framework. tasks/ + state/ + PROJECT.md are the source of truth; GSD hooks disabled in .claude/settings.json.

Content backend = Sanity.io (NOT Firestore). Reuse the blog-component library (installed as dep github:lordiwa/blog-component) and its Sanity project: projectId 'gvc4yjqj', dataset 'production' (public). Public read config (VITE_SANITY_*) is in .env.local.

Domain model: added separate Sanity doc types hueca/critico/resena (studio/schemaTypes/), reusing blockContent (PortableText). Markdown seed migrated (2 huecas, 2 criticos, 1 resena) via scripts/seed-sanity.mjs.

CRITICAL Sanity quirk: anonymous reads of gvc4yjqj/production return 0 for the API-written hueca/critico/resena docs (post/author show fine). They ARE published (verified with token). So the build-time SSG snapshot (scripts/snapshot-sanity.mjs) reads WITH a token; the tokenless src/lib/sanity.ts would return empty. Readers get static HTML (zero-JS); no runtime Sanity reads.

Firebase Auth (Google + Email/Password) live on project 'ecuahuecas' (separate Google account rmatovelle84@gmail.com; Blaze enabled). firebase.ts is lazy/SSG-safe. Gate in main.ts protects /admin/** (and /admin/usuarios admin-only); useRole reads custom claims.

4 Cloud Functions deployed in us-central1: bootstrapAdmin, grantCriticoRole, revokeCriticoRole, listCriticos. They fail closed (caller must be admin). ADMIN_EMAIL=rmatovelle84@gmail.com (admin granted via dev-only window.hacermeAdmin()).

GEN2 CALLABLE GOTCHA: Firebase Functions v2 callables must have allUsers as Cloud Run run.invoker or the browser gets a CORS/403 (preflight rejected). The CLI sets this on a clean CREATE but NOT on an update after a failed build. After deploying a new callable, verify with: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST <url> -d '{"data":{}}' — expect 401 (public, reachable), not 403 (private). Fix a 403 by deleting + recreating the function fresh.

Secrets for the A.7 Cloud Function are already in functions/.env (gitignored, NEVER commit): SANITY_WRITE_TOKEN (Administrator scope), ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_MODEL=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, ADMIN_EMAIL. Reused from blog-component/.env per user approval.

DESIGN NOTE for TASK-013: blog-component's barrel export pulls in Vue SFCs, so a pure-Node Cloud Function likely should NOT import the whole lib bundle. Prefer using @anthropic-ai/sdk + @sanity/client directly in the function (mirroring blog-component's generatePostBody forced-tool-call pattern and its image/write-adapter shape), or import only framework-agnostic pieces if cleanly resolvable.
Git: all work committed on main (branch is ahead of origin; never pushed by the agent). settings.local.json is intentionally left uncommitted. Repo uses LF→CRLF (warnings are benign).
